definition_zh: 分泌；（动、植物）分泌出；隐藏；藏匿
definition_en: to produce and release a liquid from a cell or gland, or to hide something away
core_image: 腺体像一只小水泵，把液体一滴一滴压出来
scene: 蜜蜂用腹部的腺体分泌出蜡，再一点点筑成巢室。Bees secrete wax from glands on their bodies and build the comb cell by cell.
sceneCN: 这里 secrete 是「分泌」（第 1 个义项：细胞或腺体产生并排出液体）；句意：蜜蜂用身体上的腺体分泌出蜡，再一格一格地筑成蜂巢。

derivatives.zh: 动词加后缀 -ion，义为「分泌；分泌物」
加后缀 -ory，义为「分泌的；分泌性的」
现在分词作定语，义为「有分泌功能的」
过去分词作形容词，义为「被分泌出的；被藏起来的」

senses.title: To produce and release a fluid
senses.definition: of a cell or gland, to produce and discharge a liquid
senses.definitionCN: （细胞或腺体）产生并排出液体
senses.example: The pancreas secretes insulin into the blood.
senses.exampleCN: 胰腺把胰岛素分泌到血液中。
senses.why: This is the everyday scientific sense: something formed inside is pushed out into view.
senses.whyCN: 这是日常科学中最常用的义项：体内形成的东西被推出到体外。

senses.title: To hide something away
senses.definition: to put something in a private or hidden place and keep it from being found
senses.definitionCN: 把某物放在隐秘处，不让人找到
senses.example: The documents were secreted in a locked cabinet.
senses.exampleCN: 那些文件被藏进一个上锁的柜子里。
senses.why: The word matches the Latin secretus again here, and hiding is the older and more formal sense.
senses.whyCN: 这里又回到拉丁语 secretus 的含义，隐藏是更古老、更正式的义项。

senses.title: To slip a thing quietly into place
senses.definition: to put an object somewhere without anyone noticing
senses.definitionCN: 趁人不注意把东西放到某处
senses.example: She secreted a note under the pillow.
senses.exampleCN: 她悄悄把一张字条塞到枕头下。
senses.why: Hiding is not only for long keeping, it can also mean moving quietly out of sight.
senses.whyCN: 藏匿不只是长期存放，也可以指悄悄移到看不见的地方。

senses.title: To produce a natural substance outside the body
senses.definition: used of plants and animals for waxy or sticky material pushed out of a surface
senses.definitionCN: 指动植物从表面排出蜡质或黏性物质
senses.example: Some aphids secrete a sticky honeydew.
senses.exampleCN: 有些蚜虫会分泌出黏性的蜜露。
senses.why: The biological sense broadens from glands to any outer surface that pushes a product out.
senses.whyCN: 生理义项从腺体扩展到任何向外排出产物的表面。

senses.title: To keep information away from view
senses.definition: to keep facts or documents away from people who would want them
senses.definitionCN: 把事实或文件藏起来，不让需要它的人看到
senses.example: The reports were secreted in a private archive.
senses.exampleCN: 这些报告被藏进了一处私人档案里。
senses.why: Hiding a physical thing shades naturally into hiding a fact, as both are kept out of sight.
senses.whyCN: 把实物藏起来，很自然会延伸到把事实藏起来，两者都是「不让人看见」。

intro.en: Secrete comes from Latin secretus, the past participle of secernere, to separate; the verb entered English in the secret sense and only later gained the biological meaning.
intro.cn: secrete 来自拉丁语 secretus，即 secernere（分开）的过去分词；这个动词先以「隐藏」义进入英语，很久以后才获得生理学上的「分泌」义。

items.en: Secernere means to separate, made of se-, apart, and cernere, to sift.
items.cn: secernere 意为分开，由 se-（分开）与 cernere（筛选）构成。

items.en: Secretus, set apart, describes what is hidden from ordinary view.
items.cn: secretus 意为被隔开的，用来形容藏在不常见之处的东西。

items.en: The verb secrete is recorded in English with the meaning to hide away.
items.cn: secrete 作为动词先以「隐藏」义见于英语记载。

items.en: Physiologists borrow the same form for glands that give out fluids.
items.cn: 生理学者借用同一个词形，指腺体排出液体。

items.en: The two senses live side by side, and the medical one is now the more common.
items.cn: 两个义项并存，如今医学义项更为常用。

note.en: Secrete is a double-sided verb, built on secret for hiding and used by biology for glands, so it sits near conceal and, in another direction, near exude.
note.cn: secrete 是一个双面动词：一边承袭 secret 的隐藏义，一边被生物学用来指腺体排出，所以既挨着 conceal，也挨着 exude。

entries.definition: the substance that a gland gives out
entries.definitionCN: 分泌物

entries.definition: relating to giving out a fluid
entries.definitionCN: 分泌的

entries.definition: careful about what one says
entries.definitionCN: 谨慎的；嘴严的；只是拼写相近，词源不同（来自 discernere）

entries.definition: to hide something from view
entries.definitionCN: 隐藏；隐瞒

entries.definition: to give out slowly, as through small openings
entries.definitionCN: 渗出；缓慢流出

entries.definition: to send out light, gas, or sound
entries.definitionCN: 发出（光、气体、声音）

normalIntro.en: Secrete carries two faces: one takes the hidden sense of secret, the other serves biology, where glands give out liquids.
normalIntro.cn: secrete 有两副面孔：一副继承 secret 的隐藏义，另一副服务于生物学的腺体排液。

normal.en: Secretion is the noun for what a gland gives out.
normal.cn: secretion 是表示腺体排出物的名词。

normal.en: Secretory ducts carry a fluid to the surface.
normal.cn: secretory duct 指把液体送到表面的分泌导管。

normal.en: In his novels, the victim hides the letters in a locked box for years.
normal.cn: 在他的小说里，主角把信件锁进箱子藏了多年。

normal.en: To secrete is to set apart, the same idea as the Latin secretus behind our word for a hidden thing.
normal.cn: secrete 就是「隔开」，与英语中表示隐秘之物的 secret 同出一个拉丁词 secretus。

normal.en: Compare the adjective discreet, which looks close but comes from a different Latin verb.
normal.cn: 对比形近的 discret（谨慎的），它来自另一个不同的拉丁动词。

abstract.en: Think of a gland as a small pump, pushing drops of fluid to the surface one by one.
abstract.cn: 把腺体想成一台小水泵，一滴一滴把液体推到表面。

abstract.en: Picture hands slipping an envelope into a drawer and quietly shutting it.
abstract.cn: 想象双手把一封信滑进抽屉，再悄悄合上。

abstract.en: Imagine a letter placed under a lamp base so that no one will look there.
abstract.cn: 想象一张纸条压在台灯底座下面，没人会往那里看。

examples.en: The stomach secretes acid to help break down food.
examples.cn: 胃会分泌胃酸来帮助分解食物。

examples.en: The police found the drugs secreted inside a bicycle frame.
examples.cn: 警方发现毒品被藏在一副自行车车架里面。

examples.en: Roots secrete acids that dissolve minerals in the soil.
examples.cn: 根系会分泌酸性物质，溶解土壤中的矿物质。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「司里快特」——像工厂里的一台小时泵，把溶液一滴滴挤出来；再往深处藏起，就是「藏匿」。纯属谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 se-（分开）+ cernere（筛选）→ secernere（分开）→ secretus（被隔开的）→ 英语 secrete，先取「隐藏」义，十九世纪起借作生理学的「分泌」。

sensesIntro.en: Secrete began by keeping things apart and hidden, and biology borrowed the same form for what a gland pushes out.
sensesIntro.cn: secrete 本来是把东西隔开藏起，生物学又借用这个词形，指腺体把东西排出来，两条线并行至今。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: something formed inside is pushed out, or tucked out of sight.
core.cn: 核心意象：体内形成的东西被推出来，或被塞到看不见的地方。

branches.en: Glands and plant surfaces pushing out a fluid form the biological side.
branches.cn: 腺体与植物表面排出液体，构成生物义的一项。

branches.en: Keeping something apart from view is the older hiding sense.
branches.cn: 把东西藏于视线之外，是更古老的隐藏义项。

branches.en: Quiet placement is hiding done in motion.
branches.cn: 悄悄放置就是「动态中的隐藏」。

branches.en: Hiding information extends the physical act to facts and documents.
branches.cn: 隐瞒信息把物理动作延伸到事实与文件。

branches.en: Both halves keep the Latin image of separating something from its surroundings.
branches.cn: 两半义项都保留了「把某物从环境中分出来」的拉丁意象。

intro.en: Secrete rests on the Latin sifting root cernere and the prefix se-, with -ion and -ory building the noun and adjective around it.
intro.cn: secrete 的根基是拉丁语表示「筛选」的 cernere 与前缀 se-，旁边由 -ion 与 -ory 构成名词和形容词。

latinIntro.en: Latin secernere means to separate, and secretus means set apart; the biological sense was added to English, not inherited from Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 secernere 意为分开，secretus 意为被隔开的；生理学义项是在英语内部后来才加上的，并非拉丁语原有。

items.example: The prefix se- marks separation.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 se- 标记分离。

items.example: Cernere supplies the separating image.
items.exampleCN: cernere 提供分离的意象。

items.example: Secernere is the direct Latin source.
items.exampleCN: secernere 是直接的拉丁来源。

items.example: Secretus leads to the hiding sense.
items.exampleCN: secretus 引出隐藏义项。

items.meaning: to give out a fluid, to hide
items.example: Secrete carries both senses today.
items.exampleCN: 如今 secrete 同时承担两个义项。

items.meaningCN: 表示行为或结果的词尾
items.example: The suffix -ion forms secretion.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ion 构成 secretion。

items.example: Secretion names the substance and the act.
items.exampleCN: secretion 既指分泌物也指分泌行为。

items.example: The suffix -ory forms secretory.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ory 构成 secretory。

items.example: Secretory cells line the gland.
items.exampleCN: 分泌细胞衬在腺体内壁。

definition_zh: 部分的；局部的；部门的；地区的；特殊利益的；可拼接组合的（家具）
definition_en: relating to a part or section rather than the whole, interested mainly in one group or area, or made of separate pieces that fit together
core_image: 把一整块布沿虚线剪成几片，再按需拼回一起
scene: 采购会上，老板嫌整体账目太笼统，要求按部门逐项分开核算。The director asked for a sectional analysis of costs by department instead of one lump sum.
sceneCN: 这里 sectional 是「部分的；按部分的」（第 1 个义项：把整体拆成若干部分来分析或处理）；句意：主管要求按部门做分项成本分析，而不是一个笼统的总数。

pos.zh: 部分的；局部的；部门的；地区的
特殊利益的（指只顾局部群体）
可拼接组合的；分段的（家具）

collocations.zh: 局部利益；局部群体的利益
分段主张（专利申请的拆分主张）

derivatives.zh: 由 sectional 加名词后缀 -ism，指偏重局部或地方、忽视整体的态度，常译「地方主义；派系主义」
由 sectional 加动词后缀 -ize，义为「把……分成几部分；使其局部化」
由 sectional 加副词后缀 -ly，表示「就部分而言；按地区分别地」
基础词，来自拉丁语 sectio（切割），义为「部分；切开」

senses.title: Relating to a part rather than the whole
senses.definition: concerning one part or division of something rather than the complete object
senses.definitionCN: 只涉及某物的一个部分或一个划分，而非整体
senses.example: The report gives a sectional analysis of the budget.
senses.exampleCN: 报告对预算做了分项分析。
senses.why: A section is a piece cut from a whole, so sectional describes whatever deals with such a piece on its own.
senses.whyCN: section 指从整体上切下来的一块，所以 sectional 描述只针对这一块来处理的事物。

senses.title: Narrow and self-serving interests
senses.definition: showing concern only for the interests of one group within a community
senses.definitionCN: 只关心群体内部某一小团体的利益
senses.example: Sectional interests stalled the national transport plan.
senses.exampleCN: 局部利益集团使全国交通计划停顿。
senses.why: When a group looks at the world through its own slice, the whole country becomes invisible, and sectional turns mildly critical.
senses.whyCN: 当一个群体只透过自己那一块看世界时，整体就被无视了，sectional 因而带上轻微的批评色彩。

senses.title: Made in joinable pieces
senses.definition: built from separate pieces that can be fitted together, as furniture or water pipes
senses.definitionCN: 由可拼装在一起的独立部分构成，如家具或水管
senses.example: They bought a sectional sofa for the small flat.
senses.exampleCN: 他们为那套小公寓买了一张组合式沙发。
senses.why: If a room is too small for one long couch, buy a sofa made of sections that can be arranged to fit.
senses.whyCN: 房间放不下一整条长沙发时，就买用分节块拼成、能随格局摆放的沙发。

senses.title: The furniture noun
senses.definition: a large sofa made of sections, often with a chaise or corner piece
senses.definitionCN: 由多个分段组成的大沙发，常带贵妃位或转角
senses.example: The new sectionals come in grey or sand.
senses.exampleCN: 新到的组合沙发有灰色和沙色两种。
senses.why: Because it names one object rather than a quality, the adjective becomes a countable noun in furniture shops.
senses.whyCN: 由于它命名的是一件具体物件而不是一种性质，这个形容词在家具店里就变成了可数名词。

senses.title: Viewed across groups at one time
senses.definition: comparing a population across different groups at a single point in time
senses.definitionCN: 在同一时间点上比较人群中不同组别的研究方式
senses.example: A cross-sectional survey reached farmers in five provinces.
senses.exampleCN: 一次横断面调查覆盖了五个省的农户。
senses.why: A biological cross section slices the body into visible parts, and research takes the same slice through a community to compare groups.
senses.whyCN: 生物学的横切面把身体切成可见的几块，研究中也对人群做同样的切片以便比较各组。

senses.title: Built in linked frames
senses.definition: constructed from prefabricated frames or blocks joined on site, as a boat or a garage
senses.definitionCN: 由预制框架或板块在现场连接而成，如船体或车库
senses.example: Workers lifted the sectional garage roof into place.
senses.exampleCN: 工人们把分段的车库屋顶吊装到位。
senses.why: The image of cutting a large object into pieces works in reverse here: the pieces are made first and then joined into the whole.
senses.whyCN: 「把大东西切成几块」的意象在这里反过来用：先把块做好，再把它们拼成整体。

intro.en: Sectional is built from the English noun section plus the Latin adjective suffix -al.
intro.cn: sectional 由英语名词 section 加拉丁语形容词后缀 -al 构成。

items.en: Secare means to cut, and sectio is a cutting or a division.
items.cn: secare 意为切割，sectio 指切割或划分。

items.en: The learned noun sectio is borrowed into French as section.
items.cn: 学者用语 sectio 被借入法语，写作 section。

items.en: English takes section to mean a division of a writing or a body.
items.cn: 英语借入 section，指文章或身体的划分部分。

items.en: Sectional appears for what is divided by sections, and for narrow group interests in American politics.
items.cn: sectional 出现，表示按部分划分的，又在美国政治中表示狭窄的局部利益。

items.en: The word extends to sectional furniture and to cross-sectional research.
items.cn: 该词又扩展到组合家具与横断面研究。

note.en: Sectional belongs to the cutting family of Latin secare and sits close to words for partial, local, and connected views.
note.cn: sectional 属于拉丁语 secare「切割」这一词族，并与表示局部、地方与拼接意义的词相邻。

entries.definition: a part cut or marked off from a larger whole
entries.definitionCN: 从整体中切出或划出的一部分

entries.definition: a part of an economy or an area of activity divided from the rest
entries.definitionCN: 经济或活动的划分部分，如部门、行业

entries.definition: a small group that has split from a larger religion
entries.definitionCN: 从大宗教中分裂出的小派别

entries.definition: one of the pieces into which something is divided
entries.definitionCN: 被划分出的一个片段（源自 secare 的分词）

entries.definition: concerning only a part, or favouring one side
entries.definitionCN: 只涉及部分的；偏袒一方的

entries.definition: relating to a small area rather than the whole country
entries.definitionCN: 地方的；本地的

entries.definition: belonging to one department of an organisation
entries.definitionCN: 部门的；按部门划分的

entries.definition: made of standard units that can be combined
entries.definitionCN: 模块化的；由可组合的标准单元构成的

normalIntro.en: Sectional is section plus -al: whatever belongs to one cut piece rather than the whole.
normalIntro.cn: sectional 就是 section 加 -al：凡属于切下来那一块的，而不是属于整体的。

normal.en: Section comes from Latin sectio, a cutting, so every section is something cut off.
normal.cn: section 源于拉丁语 sectio「切割」，所以每个部分都是被切出来的一块。

normal.en: Sectional often sits before analysis, interests, and furniture, three different uses of one slice.
normal.cn: sectional 常接 analysis、interests 与家具名，同一个「切片」有几种用法。

normal.en: Cross-sectional keeps the biology image of slicing a body across.
normal.cn: cross-sectional 保留着把身体横着切开的生物学意象。

normal.en: Sectionalism is the attitude, sectional the adjective, section the piece.
normal.cn: sectionalism 是态度，sectional 是形容词，section 是那一块。

normal.en: Compare partial: partial can mean unfair, while sectional mostly means divided by parts.
normal.cn: 对比 partial：partial 可指偏心，sectional 主要指按部分划分。

abstract.en: Picture an orange peeled open into neat segments on a plate.
abstract.cn: 想象一个橙子被剥开，整齐地分成几瓣摆在盘里。

abstract.en: Imagine a city map where each district is shaded a different colour.
abstract.cn: 想象一张城市地图，每个区被涂成不同颜色。

abstract.en: Think of a sofa pushed together from separate blocks to fit an odd room.
abstract.cn: 想想一张由几块拼合、为凑合别扭户型而摆的沙发。

examples.en: The team produced a sectional map of the flood damage.
examples.cn: 团队绘制了一张标注洪水损失分区的图。

examples.en: Sectional leaders blocked the reform before it reached parliament.
examples.cn: 各地方势力的领袖在改革提交议会前就把它拦下了。

examples.en: Their living room holds a green sectional under the window.
examples.cn: 他们的客厅窗下摆着一张绿色组合沙发。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「塞克申诺」——把东西塞进一格一格的「申」报单里，分开登记，就是 sect 分块的 sectional；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 secare（切割）→ sectio（切口、划分）→ 法语/英语 section（部分）＋ -al（形容词后缀）→ 英语 sectional，核心义「属于切下来那一块的」。

sensesIntro.en: Sectional starts from the plain idea of a part and branches into narrow interests, ready-made furniture, and the cross section of research.
sensesIntro.cn: sectional 从「一部分」这个朴素概念出发，又分出狭义派系利益、可拼接家具与研究的横断面几个方向。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one slice cut from a larger whole and examined on its own.
core.cn: 核心意象：从更大整体上切下的一块，被单独拿出来看。

branches.en: The plain sense simply deals with a part instead of the whole.
branches.cn: 基本义只围绕部分而不涉及整体。

branches.en: When a group sees only its slice, sectional turns into a mild criticism.
branches.cn: 一个群体只看自己那一块时，sectional 带上轻微的批评。

branches.en: Furniture made of sections makes the adjective into a shop noun.
branches.cn: 由分节块构成的家具，让形容词在家具店里变成了名词。

branches.en: Research takes a slice through a population to compare groups.
branches.cn: 研究对人群做一次切片，以比较不同组别。

branches.en: Both build the whole by joining the finished pieces.
branches.cn: 两者都是做好各块之后再拼成整体。

intro.en: Sectional is a Latin cutting root with a native English noun, wrapped in the adjective suffix -al.
intro.cn: sectional 是拉丁语「切割」词根加上英语名词，再套上形容词后缀 -al 构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin secare means to cut, and sectio means a cutting or a division.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 secare 意为切割，sectio 意为切割或划分。

items.example: Secare is the root of section and sector.
items.exampleCN: secare 是 section 与 sector 的词根。

items.example: Sectio gives the noun section.
items.exampleCN: sectio 产生名词 section。

items.example: The suffix -al turns section into sectional.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -al 把 section 变成 sectional。

items.example: Section is the base of the family.
items.exampleCN: section 是这个词族的基础词。

items.example: The suffix -ism forms sectionalism.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ism 构成 sectionalism。

items.example: The suffix -ize forms sectionalize.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ize 构成 sectionalize。

items.example: The suffix -ly forms sectionally.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ly 构成 sectionally。

items.example: Sector also comes from Latin secare.
items.exampleCN: sector 同样来自拉丁语 secare。

items.example: Dissect adds the prefix dis- to secare.
items.exampleCN: dissect 在 secare 前加了前缀 dis-。
